findings.message: In timeline "main", a tween on opacity of path ends at 4.340 s, 0.166 s after a later tween on opacity ends at 4.174 s. For that tail the earlier tween takes opacity back and leaves its own end value on screen, so the later tween's end never shows. End the earlier tween by 3.824 s, or add overwrite: "auto" to the later tween.
